author: GamingBolt
description:
It's been almost a week since Grand Theft Auto 6 launched, and the numbers only seem to be going up for Rockstar. After announcing 32.5 million pre-sales, PlayStation confirmed 39 million unique players on PS5 alone, making it the biggest launch in the brand's history. What's especially incredible is that Alinea Analytics estimates that total sales reached almost 45 million once the weekend concluded and have only been increasing since.

But if you check certain circles of the Internet, you'll notice that not everyone is exactly super-happy with their trip to Leonida. It's the nature of discourse and, well, the Internet, that differing opinions will abound. And yet, for a game that's currently the highest-rated on Metacritic, setting a new record with its 99 Metascore for raising the bar on open-world titles, among other such accolades, it's curious how the response among some players is that something feels off.
title: GTA 6 - Why Do Some GAMERS Feel Something Is OFF With It?
